answer: Stop paying for value that only circles back. Each epoch the ledger looks for closed loops in the payment and endorsement graph: groups of identities whose work is bought, rated or vouched for mostly by each other. Any credit that returns to where it started, as if the group were trading in a mirror, counts at a steep discount. An outside buyer counts in full. A farm of fakes can spin a velvet-smooth spiral of mutual praise, but none of it pays until real strangers spend on its output, and that outside demand is the one thing it cannot forge.
